fixes.explanation: Wrath is it, baker. John says the angels hold the seven final plagues, “…with which the wrath of God is completed.” (Revelation 15:1) Final means final. After these seven, there's no eighth batch waiting in the back.

Battle, baker. The spirits go out to the kings of the earth “…to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.” (Revelation 16:14) These are demonic spirits, and they perform signs as they go. I think a sign is how you get a whole crowd of kings to show up for something.

True. The verse says, “And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.” (Revelation 16:19) God is the one who remembers her and the one who gives her the cup. Nobody else hands it over.
